newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission was making a final and urgent appeal to the world's major textile exporting nations to provide offers to open their market to European textile products. These offers could enable the EU to be more generous in its own market access opening due to be presented within the GATT by the end of the year, Guilford said. He added that the Commission had not received a single answer from those countries so far.

Spokesman Nicolaas Wegter said the Commission would hold an informal meeting on Monday with Environment ministers from the Central and Eastern European countries (CEEC) candidates to join the EU. It will examine progess made by those countries in the environment field, he said.
In answer to a question, Wegter said the Commission thought the most optimistic date for CEEC countries's accession would be 2002.
Spokesman Gery Kiely briefed on the agriculture Council planned for Monday at 1500/1300 GMT.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/828: The Commission clears the acquisition by GEC Alsthom of AEG activities in the sector of transport and electricity distribution equipments.
- IP/96/829: The Commission approves the creation of a joint venture company between Hoechst Schering AgrEvo GmbH and Marubeni Corporation.
- IP/96/830: The Commission clears the acquisition of sole control of AEG AAT by Cegelec.
- Speech/96/208: Speech by Commissioner Martin Bangemann on "the way to the information society: 27 ideas for European initiatives in Central and Eastern Europe".
- Eurostat: News release No 56/96: EU industrial production unchanged.
- Eurostat: Statistics in focus, Energy and industry, 1996 No 28: Statistical aspects of the oil economy in 1995.
